ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has announced the commissioning of an additional 66.68 MW of solar capacity for its hybrid power project in Rajasthan, bringing the cumulative commissioned solar capacity to 200.04 MW out of the total 300 MW project. With a Commercial Operation Date (COD) set for November 04, 2026, this significant operational milestone is poised to drive increased revenue generation, supported by an existing Power Purchase Agreement with NTPC Limited. No red flags or material negative impacts are indicated in this positive progress update.
